name: odoo-mcp
description: Talk to any Odoo 16+ database with zero Odoo-side setup. Local stdio MCP.
long_description: Odoo MCP turns any Odoo 16+ database into a Model Context Protocol server using only your existing credentials — no App Store module, no admin access. Bounded reads, server-side aggregation, schema discovery, diagnostics, migration helpers, local BM25 knowledge search, accounting reports, and a gated write workflow with approval tokens and an audit trail. Speaks XML-RPC for Odoo 16-18 and External JSON-2 for Odoo 19+. Writes stay disabled unless you enable them in the settings.

odoo_url.title: Odoo URL
odoo_url.description: Full URL of your Odoo server, e.g. https://mycompany.odoo.com

odoo_db.title: Database name
odoo_db.description: The Odoo database to connect to

odoo_username.title: Username
odoo_username.description: Your Odoo login (usually an email address)

odoo_password.title: API key or password
odoo_password.description: An Odoo API key (Settings → My Profile → Account Security) is safer than a password. JSON-2 needs an API key.

odoo_transport.title: Transport
odoo_transport.description: xmlrpc for Odoo 16-18, json2 for Odoo 19+.

odoo_locale.title: Language
odoo_locale.description: Optional Odoo language code for results, e.g. es_ES. Leave empty for the user's language.

odoo_verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL certificate
odoo_verify_ssl.description: Turn off only for servers with a self-signed certificate.

odoo_timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
odoo_timeout.description: Timeout for each request to Odoo.

odoo_enable_writes.title: Enable writes
odoo_enable_writes.description: Allow creating, updating and deleting records. Every write still needs an approval token from a preview step.
